# Zephyr Compliance Check

Run Zephyr's CI compliance checks locally to verify BK7258 PR changes before pushing.

## Prerequisites

1. Python dependencies (install once):
   ```bash
   pip3 install python-magic unidiff pyyaml junitparser reuse yamllint pykwalify anytree gitlint-core python-dotenv west

   ```

### Full compliance check (excluding tools not installed locally)
```bash
cd /home/lijian/project/zephyr/mcu-zephyr-project/zephyr-fork-bk7258
```
